## unique-scooter

### Description and Rationale
We are an independent team from Galicia, Spain, with a strong interest in aviation, ADS-B data and open aviation research. Our involvement with the OpenSky Network through our own ADS-B receiving station sparked our interest in exploring how real-world aviation data can be used for predictive modelling. We joined the PRC Data Challenge 2026 to learn, experiment and develop a practical data-driven approach to taxi-out time prediction, while contributing to the wider open aviation community.

### Details

* Number of team members: 1
